page.layout: Single printed page, apparently blank. The only marks are mirrored show-through from the title page printed on the reverse side (a title block, a small engraving and an imprint line), which are not transcribed.
page.notes: No text printed on this side. The visible title, engraving and imprint line are mirrored show-through from the reverse, so they are left out. The reverse-side title as it reads when mirrored: "LAMENTATIONES / PROPHETAE / IEREMIAE, VARIIS / LECTIONVM VERSIVM / ... expressae, / Cum aliquot Veteris Scripturae / Cantiis. / Authore IOANNE LACOMOTO / BASILEAE. / Apud Iacobum Sacer(?), 1591." Several words of that title are too faint to read, and the reverse should be checked directly before using these readings.
